title: Veggie Ground, Carrot & Pea Skillet with Mashed Potato Topping

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice potatoes; place in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots; trim and small dice celery. Place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggie ground and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until just browned, 3-4 minutes.
While the veggie ground cooks, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the carrot and celery.
When the veggie ground is done, add veggies and spices to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften, 4-5 minutes more.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
When the potatoes are done, drain in a colander and return to the saucepan. Add milk, salt, and pepper; using a potato masher, mash until smooth. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
When the veggies are soft, add flour and cook, stirring frequently, 1 minute more.
Add tomato sauce, broth, peas, and soy sauce to the skillet; stir to combine the veggie filling and bring to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat.
Spoon mashed potatoes over the veggie filling; using a fork, evenly spread mashed potatoes over the top, creating ridges.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until the top is set and lightly golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide the skillet between plates or bowls and enjoy!
